svg.title: A terminal typing out what this account is for
svg.desc: 👋🏻 Hello World! / 🔬 Claims that survive a rerun / 💤 Builds that wait until morning / 🏗️ Keep the safe way easy / 🧰 Conventions I would pick again / 🏷️ Every build carries a version / 🎯 Covers exactly what was asked / 🪞 Lint before the pager rings / 🪵 The context in one place / 🧯 A fix without a heroic night / 📊 Numbers you can rerun later / 📖 Standards nobody can ignore / 🪄 No surprises in the build

g.text: 🧯 A fix without a heroic night
